title: 据路透，OpenAI 正赶在 Anthropic 11 月中旬上市前，以 1.4
html:
据路透，OpenAI 正赶在 Anthropic 11 月中旬上市前，以 1.4

Reuters: OpenAI is racing to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4T before Anthropic goes public.

That would put OpenAI at least 64% above the $852B valuation it reached in March.

Both labs court overlapping long-only and sovereign wealth funds, and OpenAI wants commitments before Anthropic’s filings invite side-by-side comparisons.

Those comparisons are messy: OpenAI books revenue net of partner shares, while Anthropic counts the full value of sales through cloud providers.

Locking in $1.4T before Anthropic’s public S-1 and mid-November debut spares OpenAI a direct comparison now

Anthropic’s third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $16.8B after more than doubling in the second, and the slowdown has some investors arguing for $1.5T instead of $2T.

Investors say OpenAI needs cash for infrastructure commitments in case a market that erased $1.6T from chip stocks in under 2 weeks further delays its 2027 listing.

# 据路透，OpenAI 正赶在 Anthropic 11 月中旬上市前，以 1.4

Reuters: OpenAI is racing to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4T before Anthropic goes public. 

That would put OpenAI at least 64% above the $852B valuation it reached in March. 

Both labs court overlapping long-only and sovereign wealth funds, and OpenAI wants commitments before Anthropic’s filings invite side-by-side comparisons.

Those comparisons are messy: OpenAI books revenue net of partner shares, while Anthropic counts the full value of sales through cloud providers. 
Locking in $1.4T before Anthropic’s public S-1 and mid-November debut spares OpenAI a direct comparison now

Anthropic’s third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $16.8B after more than doubling in the second, and the slowdown has some investors arguing for $1.5T instead of $2T. 

Investors say OpenAI needs cash for infrastructure commitments in case a market that erased $1.6T from chip stocks in under 2 weeks further delays its 2027 listing.
summary_zh: 据路透，OpenAI 正以 1.4 万亿美元以上估值融资约 300 亿美元，比 3 月的 8,520 亿美元估值至少高 64%，希望赶在 Anthropic 11 月中旬上市、公开 S-1 之前锁定。两家争夺同一批长线基金和主权财富基金，而 OpenAI 按扣除合作方分成后的净额记收入、Anthropic 按云渠道全额记收入，直接对比并不容易。Anthropic 第三季度营收增长 45% 至 168 亿美元，增速放缓让部分投资者主张其估值应为 1.5 万亿而非 2 万亿美元。投资人认为 OpenAI 需要现金履行基础设施承诺，以防芯片股两周蒸发 1.6 万亿美元的市场进一步推迟其 2027 年上市。
html_zh:
据路透，OpenAI 正赶在 Anthropic 11 月中旬上市前，以 1.4

路透社：在 Anthropic 上市之前，OpenAI 正在竞相以高于 1.4T 的估值筹集约 30B 美元。

这将使 OpenAI 的估值比 3 月份达到的 $852B 至少高出 64%。

这两个实验室都在寻求重叠的多头基金和主权财富基金，OpenAI 希望在 Anthropic 的文件进行并列比较之前做出承诺。

这些比较很混乱：OpenAI 计算的是扣除合作伙伴份额的收入，而 Anthropic 计算的是通过云提供商销售的全部价值。

在 Anthropic 公开 S-1 和 11 月中旬首次亮相之前锁定 1.4T 美元，让 OpenAI 现在无需进行直接比较

Anthropic 第三季度收入增长 45% 至 $16.8B，第二季度增长了一倍多，而这种放缓让一些投资者认为收入为 $1.5T，而不是 $2T。

投资者表示，OpenAI 需要现金来履行基础设施承诺，以防芯片股在不到两周内蒸发 1.6T 美元的市场进一步推迟其 2027 年上市。
